## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link relevant issues.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run check:generated`
- [ ] `npm run check:json`
- [ ] `npm test`

For visual or interaction changes, include screenshots, tested viewports/states, task outcomes, and any unverified behavior.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe API/CLI compatibility changes. Update relevant documentation and the Unreleased changelog. Include generated output when changing `src/`.
